verdict.rationale: Time logging is a fair question for a task and project management tool like Trello, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no first-party time-logging feature. Calendar sync for allocating focused time slots is time-blocking, an adjacent feature, not logging time spent against tasks. Power-Ups and the developer platform are building blocks or third-party extensions, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can log time directly against tasks and projects
